# github.com/circleci-functions/setup-browser-tools

Install browsers and browser-testing tools.

Example:
  circleci run github.com/circleci-functions/setup-browser-tools@<version> -- install-chrome --version latest

**Version:** v0.2.0
**Latest:** v0.2.0

## Commands

### setup-browser-tools/install-browser-tools

Install a default set of browsers and drivers: Chrome, ChromeDriver, Firefox and geckodriver.

| Argument                       | Type   | Default        | Description                                                               |
| ------------------------------ | ------ | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| chrome                         | bool   | true           | Install Google Chrome.                                                    |
| chromedriver                   | bool   | true           | Install ChromeDriver.                                                     |
| firefox                        | bool   | true           | Install Mozilla Firefox.                                                  |
| geckodriver                    | bool   | true           | Install geckodriver.                                                      |
| chrome-for-testing             | bool   | false          | Install Chrome for Testing.                                               |
| chrome-for-testing-driver      | bool   | false          | Install the Chrome for Testing ChromeDriver alongside Chrome for Testing. |
| edge                           | bool   | false          | Install Microsoft Edge.                                                   |
| edge-driver                    | bool   | false          | Install Edge WebDriver.                                                   |
| chrome-version                 | string | latest         | Version of Chrome to install.                                             |
| replace-existing-chrome        | bool   | false          | Replace an existing Chrome installation when it is a different version.   |
| chromedriver-install-dir       | string | /usr/local/bin | Directory to install ChromeDriver into.                                   |
| chrome-for-testing-version     | string | latest         | Version of Chrome for Testing to install.                                 |
| chrome-for-testing-install-dir | string | /usr/local/bin | Directory to symlink Chrome for Testing and its driver into.              |
| firefox-version                | string | latest         | Version of Firefox to install.                                            |
| firefox-install-dir            | string | /usr/local/bin | Directory to install Firefox into.                                        |
| geckodriver-version            | string | latest         | Release tag of geckodriver to install.                                    |
| geckodriver-install-dir        | string | /usr/local/bin | Directory to install geckodriver into.                                    |
| edge-version                   | string | latest         | Version of Edge to install.                                               |
| edge-driver-install-dir        | string | /usr/local/bin | Directory to install Edge WebDriver into.                                 |

### setup-browser-tools/install-chrome

Install Google Chrome.

| Argument         | Type   | Default | Description                                                                                                                    |
| ---------------- | ------ | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| version          | string | latest  | Version of Chrome to install, e.g. 147.0.7727.55. Defaults to the latest stable release.                                       |
| channel          | string | stable  | Release channel to install.                                                                                                    |
| replace-existing | bool   | false   | Replace an existing Chrome installation when it is a different version.                                                        |
| use-cache        | bool   | false   | Restore and save Chrome via the job cache. Increases cost and rarely speeds things up; use only when downloads are unreliable. |
| cache-key        | string | v1      | Cache key prefix, for invalidating cached entries.                                                                             |

### setup-browser-tools/install-chrome-for-testing

Install Chrome for Testing, and optionally its matching ChromeDriver.

| Argument     | Type   | Default        | Description                                                                      |
| ------------ | ------ | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| version      | string | latest         | Version of Chrome for Testing to install. Defaults to the latest stable release. |
| install-dir  | string | /usr/local/bin | Directory to symlink Chrome for Testing and its driver into.                     |
| chromedriver | bool   | true           | Also install the matching Chrome for Testing ChromeDriver.                       |

### setup-browser-tools/install-chromedriver

Install ChromeDriver, matching the installed Chrome.

| Argument    | Type   | Default        | Description                                                                                        |
| ----------- | ------ | -------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| install-dir | string | /usr/local/bin | Directory to install ChromeDriver into. Not honoured on Alpine, where the package manager chooses. |

### setup-browser-tools/install-edge

Install Microsoft Edge.

| Argument | Type   | Default | Description                                                                                   |
| -------- | ------ | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| version  | string | latest  | Version of Edge to install. Only honoured on Debian/Ubuntu; macOS always installs the latest. |

### setup-browser-tools/install-edge-driver

Install Edge WebDriver, matching the installed Edge.

| Argument    | Type   | Default        | Description                               |
| ----------- | ------ | -------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| install-dir | string | /usr/local/bin | Directory to install Edge WebDriver into. |

### setup-browser-tools/install-firefox

Install Mozilla Firefox.

| Argument    | Type   | Default        | Description                                                                                       |
| ----------- | ------ | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| version     | string | latest         | Version of Firefox to install, e.g. 149.0.2 or 140.9.1esr. Defaults to the latest stable release. |
| install-dir | string | /usr/local/bin | Directory to install Firefox into. A symlink is also created in /usr/local/bin.                   |
| use-cache   | bool   | false          | Restore and save the Firefox installer via the job cache. Ignored when --version is latest.       |
| cache-key   | string | v1             | Cache key prefix, for invalidating cached entries.                                                |

### setup-browser-tools/install-geckodriver

Install geckodriver, Mozilla's WebDriver proxy for Firefox.

| Argument    | Type   | Default        | Description                                                                          |
| ----------- | ------ | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| version     | string | latest         | Release tag of geckodriver to install, e.g. v0.36.0. Defaults to the latest release. |
| install-dir | string | /usr/local/bin | Directory to install geckodriver into.                                               |
